title: Yellow Crunchy Dutch Cheese Frittata
description: A salty and crispy Dutch dish perfect for brunch, featuring shredded Monterey Jack cheese and bonito shave, made satvik-friendly by avoiding animal by-products and focusing on plant-based ingredients where possible.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder until well combined.
Heat the olive oil in a 10-inch oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and let it cook for about 2 minutes.
Sprinkle the shredded Monterey Jack cheese and bonito shave evenly over the top of the egg mixture.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes or until the eggs are almost set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the chopped fresh parsley on top.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 1-2 minutes or until the eggs are completely set and the top is lightly browned.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
